title: WebMCP: Page Tools for Browser Agents
subtitle: document.modelContext, shared UI state, and human confirmation
angle: Expose existing page functions as typed tools so browser agents interact through validated callbacks instead of brittle DOM scraping.
value: Demonstrates how a single application function can serve both standard UI events and structured agent tool calls.
format: Architecture guide + 30-minute talk deck + 3 interactive WebMCP demos
outline: Bind UI buttons and registerTool() to the same state-update function.
Validate inputs with JSON Schema and return structured error codes with retryable.
Hold consequential actions in a pending Promise until the user confirms in the UI.
Separate read-only developer diagnostics using debugging: true.

demos.title: Reading List · Blog posts to read
demos.hook: Register a page tool that mutates the same reading list used by UI buttons.
demos.action: Ask the agent or use the UI buttons to add the small models article to your reading list.
demos.lesson: UI controls and WebMCP tools should share one validation and state layer.

demos.title: User Confirmation Gate
demos.hook: Pause a tool execution Promise until the user clicks Confirm or Reject.
demos.action: Stage a request, click Reject to verify nothing commits, then stage again and click Confirm.
demos.lesson: consequentialHint is metadata only; confirmation must be enforced in application code.

demos.title: Schema & Error Inspector
demos.hook: Inspect registered JSON Schemas, debugging annotations, and error responses.
demos.action: Run a valid query, test an empty query vs. malformed JSON, and toggle debugging tools.
demos.lesson: Distinguish JSON parsing errors from recoverable application errors.

title: Session Lifecycle & Permissions Policy
subtitle: availability(), streaming cancellation, and cross-origin iframe delegation
angle: Handle capability states, user-initiated model preparation, AbortController cancellation, and iframe Permissions-Policy headers.
value: Provides reusable patterns for session management, memory cleanup, and embedded cross-origin demos.
outline: Check availability() without triggering automatic model downloads.
Create sessions on explicit user action and monitor downloadprogress.
Pass an AbortSignal to promptStreaming() and destroy sessions on completion.
Delegate access to cross-origin iframes via allow="language-model".

demos.title: API Availability Inspector
demos.hook: Query availability() across LanguageModel, Summarizer, Translator, and Detector.
demos.action: Click Check Browser APIs to inspect current status, then test session creation.
demos.lesson: Always check availability() before calling create().

demos.title: Streaming & AbortController
demos.hook: Stream incremental output and abort an active generation mid-stream.
demos.action: Start the simulated or native stream and click Cancel midway to test AbortSignal handling.
demos.lesson: Pass an AbortSignal to streaming calls and destroy the session in a finally block.

demos.title: Cross-Origin Iframe Policy
demos.hook: Test Permissions-Policy delegation for language-model inside an iframe.
demos.action: Load the iframe probe with and without allow="language-model" enabled.
demos.lesson: Embedded frames require explicit Permissions-Policy delegation to access Built-in AI.

title: On-Device Embeddings & Grounded RAG
subtitle: SemanticEmbedder, cosine similarity, and threshold-gated prompting
angle: Compare lexical word overlap against on-device vector embeddings, inspect similarity thresholds, and gate RAG prompts on retrieved evidence.
value: Shows how to combine SemanticEmbedder task types with LanguageModel prompting in client-side RAG pipelines.
outline: Index documents with taskType: "retrieval-document" and queries with "retrieval-query".
Compute cosine similarity and re-index whenever the embedding model changes.
Use taskType: "semantic-similarity" for pairwise deduplication.
Abstain from calling LanguageModel when no passage clears the similarity threshold.

demos.title: Semantic vs. Lexical Search
demos.hook: Rank passages by cosine similarity vs. deterministic word overlap.
demos.action: Run lexical search and native embedding search on the same query to compare rankings.
demos.lesson: Use retrieval-document and retrieval-query task hints when generating embeddings.

demos.title: Pairwise Similarity Matrix
demos.hook: Compute all-pairs similarity scores across short notes and filter by threshold.
demos.action: Add a note, compute similarity scores, and adjust the threshold slider.
demos.lesson: Cosine similarity thresholds must be calibrated to the specific embedding model.

demos.title: Threshold-Gated RAG
demos.hook: Inspect retrieved passages and block generation when similarity falls below the floor.
demos.action: Run retrieval, raise the threshold until 0 passages match, and verify drafting is disabled.
demos.lesson: Gate LLM generation on retrieval quality so weak matches abstain early.

title: Latency Profiling & Context Budgets
subtitle: Setup vs. first-chunk timing, Summarizer options, and measureContextUsage()
angle: Instrument session creation time, time-to-first-chunk, total generation time, Summarizer option constraints, and token usage.
value: Replaces anecdotal speed claims with structured client-side telemetry and runtime context checks.
outline: Record session setup, first-chunk latency, and total generation time separately.
Export JSON trial logs with browser version and configuration metadata.
Validate Summarizer preference: "speed" constraints (English, key-points/tldr, short/medium).
Query session.contextWindow and measureContextUsage() at runtime.

demos.title: Streaming Latency Profiler
demos.hook: Measure setupMs, firstChunkMs, generationMs, and chars/sec on native sessions.
demos.action: Run a native streaming trial and export the recorded JSON telemetry.
demos.lesson: Separate cold session initialization from warm token generation latency.

demos.title: Summarizer Option Validator
demos.hook: Check option compatibility for Summarizer speed vs. capability modes.
demos.action: Inspect the default incompatible combination, click Apply Valid Speed Options, and compare.
demos.lesson: The Summarizer speed specialist only supports English key-points/tldr in short/medium lengths.

demos.title: Context Window Token Counter
demos.hook: Measure prompt token consumption against session.contextWindow.
demos.action: Toggle context passages and run measureContextUsage() to inspect token counts.
demos.lesson: Read contextWindow and measureContextUsage() dynamically instead of hardcoding token limits.

title: Prompt Templates & Task Polyfills
subtitle: Structured prompt builders, citation checks, and Task API comparisons
angle: Build explicit prompt templates over LanguageModel, verify output identifiers, and compare custom prompts against Summarizer.
value: Shows when to use a dedicated Task API versus a custom prompt template over LanguageModel.
outline: Separate user data from system instructions in reusable prompt builders.
Validate generated outputs against input reference IDs ([R1], [R2]).
Compare Summarizer.summarize() against custom LanguageModel prompts on identical inputs.
Keep human review in the loop before publishing generated text.

demos.title: Parameterized Rewrite Prompt
demos.hook: Assemble a constrained rewrite prompt from tone and audience parameters.
demos.action: Change Tone and Audience, inspect the assembled prompt string, and run generation.
demos.lesson: Keep prompt templates inspectable and separate source data from instructions.

demos.title: Changelog Citation Checker
demos.hook: Draft release notes from tagged items ([R1]–[R3]) and verify cited IDs.
demos.action: Test duplicate IDs to see validation fail, then generate a draft and check cited tags.
demos.lesson: Pair generative drafting with deterministic post-checks on required identifiers.

demos.title: Summarizer vs. Custom Prompt
demos.hook: Compare Summarizer API output with a custom LanguageModel prompt side by side.
demos.action: Run both native paths on the same passage and record your evaluation.
demos.lesson: Benchmark task-specific APIs against custom prompts on your own domain text.

title: Translation, Detection & Proofreading
subtitle: Translator, LanguageDetector, and Proofreader API workflows
angle: Combine on-device language detection, bidirectional translation, and reviewable proofreading while preserving the user’s original text.
value: Practical UI patterns for multilingual inputs without auto-overwriting user text.
format: UI pattern guide + 3 multilingual API demos
outline: Check Translator language-pair availability before initiating translation.
Display LanguageDetector candidate rankings and confidence scores.
Keep original text visible alongside translated or proofread output.
Let users accept or reject Proofreader corrections explicitly.

demos.title: Bidirectional Translator
demos.hook: Check language-pair availability and translate between Spanish and English.
demos.action: Check pair availability, run native translation, and switch direction.
demos.lesson: Preserve the source message alongside its translation so users can verify accuracy.

demos.title: Language Detector Confidence
demos.hook: Inspect ranked language candidates on long, short, and code-switched inputs.
demos.action: Switch between the long, short, and mixed samples and run native detection.
demos.lesson: Short or mixed-language strings produce lower-confidence candidate distributions.

demos.title: Proofreader Diff & Review
demos.hook: Run on-device English proofreading and accept or discard the proposed fix.
demos.action: Run proofreading, test Keep Original, then run again and click Accept Correction.
demos.lesson: Stage grammar corrections for review instead of silently mutating the user’s input.

title: Structured Output & Abstention Routing
subtitle: JSON Schema responseConstraint, deterministic rules, and review lanes
angle: Use LanguageModel with JSON Schema responseConstraint for classification, combine it with deterministic rules, and route ambiguous cases to human review.
value: Concrete implementation of structured classification with an explicit abstention/review lane.
outline: Enforce output structure with responseConstraint JSON Schema.
Include an explicit review/abstain enum value for ambiguous inputs.
Combine deterministic regex/length rules with model classification.
Measure accepted error rate vs. abstention coverage on a labeled test set.

demos.title: JSON Schema Ticket Router
demos.hook: Classify support messages into billing, technical, or review with responseConstraint.
demos.action: Run the deterministic keyword baseline, then compare with native structured classification.
demos.lesson: Always include an explicit review/abstain category in classification schemas.

demos.title: Rule + Model Pre-Moderation
demos.hook: Combine deterministic link/length checks with structured Prompt API routing.
demos.action: Test a comment containing a URL with deterministic rules and native classification.
demos.lesson: Enforce hard invariants with deterministic code before consulting a language model.

demos.title: Abstention vs. Error Evaluator
demos.hook: Evaluate coverage, abstentions, and accepted errors across 8 labeled test cases.
demos.action: Run the baseline evaluator, adjust the margin slider, and inspect per-item results.
demos.lesson: Routing uncertain cases to review reduces accepted errors at the cost of coverage.
